shared_elements: large rounded monolithic mass suggestive of a head/upper body
faint curvilinear or circular relief marking on the stone surface
justification: Both surfaces present a massive, blocky rounded form that can be read as a schematic human head/torso, and in each there are faint low-relief curvilinear or circular markings on the swelling upper surface; that is about the limit of the correspondence. B clearly shows an organised iconographic programme on the back of a standing figure — paired rings, a curvilinear collar-like motif, and a horizontal belt band with pendent element — while A shows no legible arrangement of motifs at all, only an amorphous lichen-covered mass with at best one ambiguous curved line, so no shared scheme of relationships or placement can be demonstrated.
